newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea's 1996 gold imports, exports surge on yr.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea's 1996 gold imports, exports surge on yr.

text.p: South Korea's imports of gold in unwrought, semi-manufactured or powder form and of 24K gold coin rose 95.2 percent to 424.4 tonnes in 1996 from 217.4 tonnes a year ago, the Bank of Korea said on Wednesday.
Gold exports for the same year surged 116 percent to 427.3 tonnes from 197.8 tonnes in 1995.
Australia was the biggest supplier to South Korea by shipping 179.3 tonnes, followed by Switzerland and South Africa which supplied 81.5 tonnes and 50.6 tonnes, respectively.

Singapore was the biggest buyer of South Korean gold by taking 143 tonnes. Hong Kong imported 113.5 tonnes of gold from South Korea, Malaysia 60.7 tonnes, Taiwan 41.6 tonnes, Switzerland 27.9 tonnes and Japan 25.3 tonnes.

Imports of gold in lumps, billets and grains rose 87 percent to 388.7 tonnes from 207.8 tonnes a year ago, while exports in lumps, billets and grains jumped 99.8 percent to 383.8 tonnes from 192.1 tonnes.
